description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Selesnya Sanctuary onto the battlefield.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token's trigger, putting Selesnya Sanctuary onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
